feature_definitions.anchoring: tag anchored to enrichment line iff they share >=1 stemmed non-stopword token (stem: -ies->y, -es, -s; stopwords: the/a/an/of/in/on/for/and/or/to/with/at/by/from/as/is/are/was/were/be/been/it/its/this/that/these/those). Recovered EXACTLY: reproduces per_line_counts/anchored/window_only/neither on 70/70 conv_bench ranked rows.
feature_definitions.per_line_max_frac: max over enrichment lines of (#tags anchored to that line)/n_tags (tags multi-count across lines)
feature_definitions.coherence: mean pairwise Jaccard of stemmed content-word sets between enrichment lines (undefined for 1-line tasks; 1/70)
feature_definitions.win_enr_sim: Jaccard(window stemmed content words, union of enrichment stemmed content words)

coherence_confound_test.verdict: NOT a coherence confound: coherence has zero independent effect on rel once plmf is held; plmf keeps 87% of its raw r under the coherence control

mismatch_moderator_test.verdict: mismatch characterizes the extreme-loser tail (all 7 counterexamples) but does NOT carry the correlation

task_determined_vs_chosen.reading: measured task properties (coherence, mismatch, n_lines, sizes, char-share, cohort difficulty) explain only 28% of plmf variance; the remaining 72% is the answer/pipeline side OR the unmeasured latent (whether our predicted-GT landed on the true GT topic). That latent is uncontrollable observationally (judge mapping lost).

interventional_record_contradicts_causal.observational_slope: rel = +0.174*plmf (se 0.038); IQR 0.65->0.90 implies +0.044 rel if causal
interventional_record_contradicts_causal.de_concentration_tested: ARM C value-alloc -0.0132 (29 improved/177 degraded); per-line quota W/L 30/50 - moving DOWN the axis hurts far less than slope predicts and moving coverage up never helped
interventional_record_contradicts_causal.up_concentration_analog_tested: greedy score-maximising composer +0.004 ns, loses 11/17; centroid improvement ceiling +0.0036; demote knob inert (0-1 answers changed)
interventional_record_contradicts_causal.conclusion: concentration behaves as a SYMPTOM of the latent 'candidate pool aligned with true GT topic', which causes both concentration and winning; every attempt to force the symptom (either direction) was neutral-to-negative

counterexamples.shared_fingerprint: window/enrichment topic mismatch + decoy homonym enrichment lines + heavy singular/plural variant crowding

verdict_reason: signal survives every measured control (partial r 0.39-0.48, p<0.001) and is era-stable, so it does not collapse; but no deployable intervention is identifiable: forcing concentration up is the failed greedy-composer family, forcing it down is the rejected ARM C/quota family, and the observational slope is contradicted by that interventional record. Remaining decisive test: recompose captured tasks with a dominant-cluster bonus and score BOTH arms against FRESH frozen-GT draws (the blended proxy structurally rewards centroid-collapse and cannot adjudicate this); secondary untested angle: cap inflectional variants on mismatch tasks.
